descriptionChirho: To meditate, muse, or reflect quietly, typically on God's works, law, or statutes; an internal contemplative activity (Qal).
To speak, talk, or converse with someone; external verbal communication or discourse about a subject (Qal).
To complain, lament, or pour out one's grievance; a specific speech act expressing distress or sorrow before God (Qal).
To consider, reflect upon, or ponder deeply; the Piel intensive of meditation conveying careful, sustained deliberation or examination (Piel).
